text: As an appointee by the City of Toronto the Board of Directors of the Good Roads Association, I attended the Annual Conference held on Sunday April 16 through to Wednesday April 19, 2023. This year's conference focused on the latest developments in transportation infrastructure, including new technologies and funding models. My participation included attending: Conference - Good Roads Board of Directors Meetings Board of Directors and Advisory Board of Past Presidents Ontario Good Roads Association Elections Installation of President Opening Reception President’s Reception and Dinner Intact Public Entities XChange Reception Sessions Technical Session Plenary Sessions Concurrent Sessions Study Tours Metrolinx Study Tour, Nuclear Waste Management, Waterfront Toronto Don River Rehabilitation, Toronto Traffic Management Centre, and Pave-Al I was honored to be elected as the 3 rd Vice…

City Council on May 10, 11 and 12, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the update on the Board of Directors of the Good Roads Association 129th Annual Conference held on April 16 - April 19, 2023 for information.
